highlights_headline: SkiaSharp 4.151.0 updates the bundled renderer to Skia m151 and reduces common managed allocations.
highlights_body: The release improves color conversion, parsing, shaping, and WebAssembly delivery while preserving the managed API surface.

bullets.detail: Includes the m151 engine update and subsequent upstream bug-fix merges.

bullets.lead: Color, parsing, and shaping allocations reduced
bullets.detail: Moves common color conversions to managed code and avoids transient allocations in tag parsing and text shaping.

bullets.lead: Encoded image subset resources are released correctly
bullets.detail: Fixes a native resource leak when decoding a subset from encoded image data.
Adds Emscripten 5.0.6 libraries with current exception-handling support for WebAssembly applications.

contributor_summaries.ramezgerges: WebAssembly build cleanup and .NET 11 asset delivery improvements

preview_summaries.v4.151.0-preview.1.1: Preview 1 opened the m151 line with the Skia engine update.
preview_summaries.v4.151.0-preview.2.1: Preview 2 delivered allocation reductions, shaping improvements, and encoded-image lifetime fixes.
preview_summaries.v4.151.0-rc.1.1: Release Candidate 1 finalized m151 engine fixes and WebAssembly delivery.

harfbuzz_summary: Makes UTF-8 shaping and tag parsing allocation-conscious while refreshing WebAssembly HarfBuzz delivery.
